essence: Full-I-grasp woven of a-to-ha sound-mass grounds identity: Śiva Himself the thirty-six-leveled display; level defined as undivided shine familying the divided; roll bare.

sections.SUMMARY: Full-I-grasp woven of a-to-ha sound-mass grounds identity: Śiva Himself the thirty-six-leveled display. Level means the undivided shine that families the divided, hill-earth and river-water exhibited. Then the roll, bare, one to thirty-six.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: letters pregnant with worlds, one shine familying many. Fecundity relished.
